description: Implement Scene001 First Breath - cinematic environment systems including: particle family architecture (Ambient Dust + Stars enabled), CameraController with drift/parallax, cinematic fog layer, star twinkle system, multi-source ambient lighting, enhanced background gradients, UniverseLayerManager, Scene001_FirstBreath registration, audio architecture stub, and cinematic vignette. All synchronized through TimeEngine.
steps: Create js/engine/universe/ParticleFamilies.js - Define particle family configurations (ambientDust, stars, energy, connections, ai, revenue, trust). Each family has independent config: count, speed range, size range, opacity range, lifetime range, color, depth range, behavior type. Export PARTICLE_FAMILIES frozen config object. Only ambientDust and stars are enabled for Scene001.

Refactor js/engine/universe/ParticleEngine.js - Support multiple particle families. Add setFamilies(familyConfigs) method. Pool is partitioned by family. Each family has its own activation config (size, speed, lifetime, color, opacity). Update the render method to support per-family coloring. Keep object pooling and batched rendering. Update activateParticle to use family config. Add a family field to each particle object.

Create js/engine/universe/StarTwinkleSystem.js - Reusable star behavior system. Each star has: brightness, lifetime, randomInterval, fadeInDuration, fadeOutDuration, active state, timer. Stars twinkle independently (no synchronized flashing). Uses noise/random for natural timing. Integrates with particle system - stars are a particle family with twinkle behavior overlay. Update method takes (deltaTime, elapsedTime). Respects reduced motion (fewer twinkles, slower).

Create js/engine/universe/CameraController.js - Virtual 2D camera abstraction. Properties: position {x, y}, rotation, zoom, drift velocity, parallaxFactor. Slowly drifts over time using noise (from TimeEngine). Movement is almost invisible. Methods: init(), update(deltaTime, elapsedTime), getTransform(), getParallaxOffset(depth), setTarget(x, y), reset(). No Three.js. Just a coordinate system that other layers can query for offset/parallax. Respects reduced motion (less drift).

Create js/engine/universe/FogRenderer.js - Cinematic fog layer. Very soft, layered, barely visible. Creates depth without obscuring content. Multiple fog layers at different depths with different speeds. Rendered as semi-transparent radial/linear gradients that shift with noise over time. Reacts to: time, noise, future lighting. Has init(), update(deltaTime, elapsedTime), render(ctx, width, height), resize(), setReducedMotion(). Uses Noise for organic movement.

Create js/engine/universe/VignetteRenderer.js - Cinematic vignette overlay. Dark edges fading to transparent center. Subtle but present. Adds cinematic framing. render(ctx, width, height) draws a radial gradient vignette. Can be adjusted by intensity parameter.

Create js/engine/universe/GradientRenderer.js - Multi-layer background gradients. Replaces/enhances the simple deep space fill. Multiple independent gradient layers that shift very slowly. Think nebula - subtle purple/blue tones barely visible against the dark. Each gradient layer has: position, radius, color, opacity, drift speed. All driven by TimeEngine/noise. render(ctx, width, height, elapsedTime).

Enhance js/engine/universe/LightingEngine.js - Support multiple independent light sources: primary, secondary, accent. Each source has its own: position, color, opacity, noise seed, breath speed. All breathe independently but from the same TimeEngine clock. render() draws multiple radial gradients. Future scenes can control each source independently.

Create js/engine/universe/UniverseLayerManager.js - Central registry for all environmental layers. Layers register with: id, zIndex, category (environment, content, ui), renderFn, updateFn, active state. Provides: registerLayer(), unregisterLayer(), setLayerActive(), getLayersByCategory(). Future layers (Earth, Phone, Marketplace, AI, Infrastructure, Glass UI, Typography) will plug into this. For now only environment layers register. Replaces/wraps BackgroundRenderer layer system or works alongside it.

Create js/scenes/Scene001_FirstBreath.js - The first cinematic scene. Lifecycle methods: load(), enter(), update(deltaTime), leave(), destroy(). On enter: activates ambientDust + stars families, enables fog layer, enables gradient layer, enables vignette, starts camera drift, sets lighting theme to 'dark'. Does NOT contain any product content. Registers with SceneManager as 'scene001_firstBreath'.

Create js/engine/universe/AudioArchitecture.js - Audio support stub (no playback). Defines audio channel types: ambientDrones, particleWhispers, glassInteractions, environmentalSounds. Muted by default. Has init(), setMuted(bool), getChannel(name), destroy(). Architecture only - no actual audio loading or playback. Future tasks will implement.
Update js/config/constants.js - Add PARTICLE_FAMILIES enum, CAMERA_DEFAULTS, FOG_CONFIG, AUDIO_CHANNELS, LAYER_CATEGORIES constants.
Update js/config/settings.js - Add scene001 config block, camera config, fog config, vignette config, and audio architecture config (all frozen).

Update js/engine/universe/UniverseEngine.js - Integrate CameraController, FogRenderer, VignetteRenderer, GradientRenderer, StarTwinkleSystem, UniverseLayerManager. Wire all to TimeEngine. Pass camera parallax offsets to particle rendering. Add fog and vignette as layers. Update the update() loop to tick all new systems.
Update js/engine/Engine.js - On init, after universe is initialized, load and enter Scene001_FirstBreath via SceneManager. Wire up scene lifecycle.
Update js/app.js if needed - Ensure Scene001 activates on page load through Engine.init() flow.
Create css/fog.css - Styles for any DOM-based fog elements (if used alongside canvas).
Create css/vignette.css - Vignette overlay styles if any DOM element is used.
Update css/main.css - Import new CSS files (fog.css, vignette.css) in correct order.
Ensure all new systems respect reduced motion: camera drift reduced, star twinkle frequency reduced, fog movement reduced, breathing reduced. Atmosphere maintained.
Ensure zero allocations in all render/update loops. All systems use pre-allocated data structures.
Verify no function > 60 lines, no class > 400 lines, all public APIs have JSDoc, no magic numbers.
acceptance_criteria: All new JS files parse without syntax errors (valid ES2022 modules)
All import paths resolve to existing files
ParticleEngine supports multiple families with independent configs
Only ambientDust and stars families are active for Scene001
CameraController provides noise-driven drift and parallax offsets
FogRenderer draws layered cinematic fog reacting to time/noise
GradientRenderer draws multiple slowly-shifting nebula-like gradients
StarTwinkleSystem provides natural unsynchronized star brightness changes
UniverseLayerManager provides layer registration architecture for future content
Scene001_FirstBreath registers with SceneManager and activates environment on enter
AudioArchitecture stub exists with channel types defined (muted, no playback)
Everything synchronized from TimeEngine - no independent timers
Reduced motion respected across all new systems
No function > 60 lines, no class > 400 lines
Visual result: deep dark universe with subtle gradients, fog, drifting particles (dust + twinkling stars), breathing light, vignette edges, imperceptible camera drift
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check on every new and modified JS file
Verify all import paths exist by checking file system
Verify no class exceeds 400 lines by checking line counts
Verify constants/settings have no magic numbers in engine code
findings: All 18 new+modified JS files pass NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check. No class exceeds 400 lines (max is 279). No function exceeds 60 lines. All import paths resolve. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install possible, no Docker available. Used syntax checking only for verification.
